public_rationale: AP announced on July 13, 2023 that OpenAI was licensing part of its text archive [e7]. OpenAI announced a partnership on December 13, 2023 that included using Axel Springer content for model training [e8]. These agreements support the factual claim that OpenAI had pursued licensing before January 8, 2024 and knew it was possible for selected content [e7, e8]. The supported assessment covers that factual claim only; the agreements do not establish that OpenAI knowingly made a false argument [e7, e8].
limitations: The records do not establish OpenAI's private beliefs about its argument or an intent to deceive [e7, e8].
The agreements do not establish the cost or feasibility of licensing an entire training corpus [e7, e8].
